caption:
A full shelf feels safe. It can also be the most expensive thing in your business. Every rupee sitting in a slow carton is a rupee that cannot restock the product that IS selling. The slides cover four truths about stock and cash, including why the first markdown is always the cheapest one.

What is the oldest carton in your stock room? Go check the date on it and tell us in the comments how long it has been waiting.

#OnlineSellingIndia #EcommerceIndia #SmallBusinessIndia #InventoryManagement #SellerTips
